question.text: Find the right condition(s) for Fraunhoffer difiraction due to a single slit.

options.text: Source is at infinite distance and the incident beam has converged at the slit
Source is near to the slit and the incidont beam is parallel
Source is at infinity and the incident beam is parallel
Source is near to the slit and the incident beam has converged at the slit

solution.text:
For Fraunhofer diffraction, incident beam should
be parallel. This can be achieved when
(a) Source is placed at focus of converging lens.
(b) Source is at infinite distance.
